name: op-secret-read
description: Block 1Password CLI invocations that print secrets or tokens.

rules.name: block-op-read
rules.reason: op read prints a secret reference value.

rules.name: block-op-inject
rules.reason: op inject prints a template with secrets substituted.

rules.name: block-op-item-reveal
rules.reason: This op item get form prints a concealed value, a one-time password, or a shareable link.

rules.name: block-op-document-get
rules.reason: op document get downloads document content.

rules.name: block-op-signin-raw
rules.reason: op signin --raw prints a session token.

rules.name: block-op-connect-token-create
rules.reason: op connect token create prints a new Connect token.

rules.name: block-op-service-account-create
rules.reason: op service-account create prints a service account token.
